about: The runes sounds: 48 kHz 16-bit mono WAVs, every file's peak at -1 dBFS. Play a sound at its "gain" (multiply) so the set is levelled against itself: swings under hits, hits under heavy hits, the finishing blow the loudest. Pick one of the files at random each time. loud_db: the loudest 50 ms of the file before the gain; target_db: where it should sit (the sword's hit = about 0).

storm_rise_v.use: the storm rising over the altar as the stones turn, once, about 3.5 s (the studio's, layered)

storm_rise_a.use: the storm rising over the altar as the stones turn, once, about 3.5 s (plain, as recorded)

rune_carve_a.use: the chosen stones showing their carvings, about 2 s (plain, as recorded)

stone_break_v.use: the two other stones breaking just after the strike (the studio's, layered)
